description: This PHP source file defines the class TaggedHandlersPass, which implements a compiler pass for the Drupal dependency injection container. It processes service tags related to service collection and ID collection, enabling dynamic injection of services based on tags and priorities.

classes.name: TaggedHandlersPass
classes.description: Implements a compiler pass to process service tags for collecting handler services and service ID collections, enabling dynamic service injection based on tags and priorities.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Main method that processes the container to find tagged services and delegates to specific processing methods for service collectors and ID collectors.

methods.name: processServiceCollectorPass
methods.description: Processes a service collector tag, adding method calls to inject tagged services into the consumer service based on interface type and priority.

methods.name: processServiceIdCollectorPass
methods.description: Processes a service ID collector tag, injecting an array of service IDs into the consumer service based on priority.

methods.name: resolveDefinitionClass
methods.description: Resolves the class name of a service definition, including handling parent definitions in case of child definitions.
